update_up_to_date: You are on the latest version.
update_available_confirm: Version {version} is available. Install and restart now?
update_error: Could not check or install updates. Confirm the GitHub release endpoint and updater public key are configured.
update_unavailable: Updates are available only in the desktop application.
onboard_body: Portal is a self-contained VPN client for OpenVPN and GlobalProtect. Import .ovpn profiles or create GlobalProtect portals. Both tunnels can run at once. On Linux, connecting may show a polkit prompt. OpenVPN and gpclient are bundled when available.
desktop_required: Open the desktop application to import profiles and connect.
no_profiles: No profiles yet. Import a file or folder to begin.
no_gp_profiles: No GlobalProtect profiles yet. Create one to begin.
connecting: Connecting. Authenticate with polkit if prompted.
confirm_delete_profile: Delete this profile from Portal? Local copies of the config will be removed.
confirm_delete_gp_profile: Delete this GlobalProtect profile from Portal?
logs_empty: Logs appear here when you connect.
perf_idle: Connect a profile to see live speeds.
setting_kill_switch_hint: Kill switch uses elevated nftables rules and may interrupt other network traffic until cleared. Dual tunnels share one allowlist for tun interfaces.
setting_elevate: Elevate with polkit / admin on connect
setting_tray: System tray is always on. Closing the window hides Portal to the tray. Use Quit in the tray menu to disconnect and exit.
tray_needs_auth: Sign in is required for this portal.
setting_credential_store_hint: If OS keyring fails with a DBus or Secret Service error, choose This session only.
gp_section_portal_hint: Host and gateway used to reach your GlobalProtect portal.
gp_section_auth_hint: Use Username and password when the portal shows a local login form. Use System browser SSO only when IT confirmed SAML or Microsoft Entra sign-in for GlobalProtect. Many portals still use a local VPN password even if your mailbox is Microsoft 365.
gp_section_certs_hint: Only for mutual TLS client auth (your user cert plus private key). Do not import gateway or CA .crt files here. Leave empty for username/password or SSO.
gp_auth_microsoft_hint: A Microsoft mailbox does not always mean GlobalProtect uses browser SSO. If Connect fails with non-SAML or auth-failed under SSO, switch to Username and password and use the VPN account password from IT (it may differ from Outlook).
gp_empty_body: Create a portal with plus, or choose one from the list to edit and connect.
gp_as_gateway: Connect as gateway (server is a gateway, not a portal)
gp_certs_skip_hint: Gateway or CA certificates (names like cert_GlobalProtect or cert_GW) are not imported here. Use Portal host and Authentication instead.
profile_icon_preview_hint: Preview for the profile list and header.
